cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Our toaster receipt is gone. The shop must have someone inside this house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I probably recycled it. We can get a copy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. So the recycling crew removes originals while the shop prints replacements.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every shop? Then it's the whole high street. We can't trust a single warranty.
